param_input_item.param_description: Vector of break points, of length pieces + 1.
Matrix of polynomial coefficients, of size (pieces * prod(d)) by order. Each row holds the coefficients of one polynomial piece from the highest power to the constant term.
Dimension of the values of the piecewise polynomial (default 1).

param_output_item.param_description: Piecewise polynomial structure with fields form, breaks, coefs, pieces, order and dim.

description.p: mkpp builds a piecewise polynomial structure from its break points and coefficients. The structure can then be evaluated with ppval.
For each piece, the polynomial is evaluated in the local variable x - breaks(i), where breaks(i) is the left break point of the piece.
The number of pieces is numel(breaks) - 1 and the order is the number of columns of coefs.
